values: 一名生性懒散的吸血鬼，擅长以鲜血契约驱使眷属作战。
An indolent vampire who commands her thralls through blood pacts to aid her in battle.
I'll step in when the time comes.
余就勉为其难，收下这力量。
Well, I'll take it if you insist.
I'm not... trying to slack off...
Don't turn to me if you need help.
So, what is it you need to see me about?
哈啊……嗯？嗯，这样啊……真有趣
Hmm... Oh? Alright... now that's interesting.
哼~哼~哼~哈啊……余该去小憩了
*Humming* Ah... Time for a little nap.
竟然能从你手中收到不错的礼物，真是难得呀。
Wow, you finally gave me something decent for once.
暂且放一旁吧，待余有空再仔细欣赏。
I'll admire it later, when I have time.
谁说优雅与慵懒不是危险的代名词？
Who says danger can't come wrapped in elegance and languor?
最毒的蛊术，莫过于直击人心的言语。
Words that strike the heart can be deadlier than any poison.
通过命途星轨活动获得。
The decor is a bit underwhelming, to say the least.
可有人能猜中余的口味？呵呵
I wonder if anyone could guess my tastes. Heh.
苔佩希的高脚杯中永远装着鲜红清澈的液体，绝大多数情况下，那只是红酒。
Tephesia's goblet is always full of a clear, ruby-red liquid. Most of the time, it really is just red wine.
多亏莫蒂默家族的精心培育，苔佩希拥有极高的艺术造诣。但比起创作，她更喜欢欣赏——粗略地、大而化之地欣赏。

The Mortimer family gave Tephesia a fine education in the arts. She'd rather admire a work than create one, though. She prefers to take in the overall effect and leave the finer points to someone else.
对于诺珐斯居民来说，苔佩希算得上是一位称职的领主——毕竟在这座慢悠悠的亡灵城镇里，每隔十几年甚至几十年才会发生一件值得关注的大事。
By the standards of Novaris, Tephesia governs well enough. In this sleepy Graveborn town, a decade can go by before anything merits her attention. Sometimes several.
苔佩希时常后悔自己过早展现出了非凡的魔法天赋，以至于被始祖早早转化为吸血鬼，否则她本可以再长高一些的。

Tephesia sometimes wishes she'd kept her gift for magic to herself a little longer. Lord Progenitor might have waited to turn her into a vampire, and she might have had time to grow another inch or two.
与其他高阶吸血鬼相比，苔佩希所转化的眷属少之又少，其中最为得力的便是埃德加。即便如此，苔佩希依然很讨厌被他称为“母亲大人”。
For a vampire of her rank, Tephesia has turned remarkably few people into vampire thralls. Eryndor has proved the most capable of the lot, but she still can't stand it when he calls her "Mother".
迄今为止，苔佩希处理公务的最高效率是：一天之内翻看了十二页文件，写了八个字，盖了三枚章。
On her most productive day in office, Tephesia leafed through twelve pages, wrote eight words, and stamped three documents.
早在诺珐斯归顺班题斯以前，苔佩希就已经开始遣散庄园内的血仆。这或许是出于她对她亲生父母的情感，尽管她一直坚称她早已忘却他们的模样。

Long before Novaris pledged allegiance to Bantus, Tephesia had already begun dismissing the blood servants at her manor. Perhaps she was thinking of her birth parents, though she's always insisted she no longer remembers their faces.
根据诺珐斯本地的记载，苔佩希继承领主之位已经近两百年。但实际上，莫蒂默始祖为她制定的任期尚未过半。
According to local records, Tephesia has ruled Novaris for nearly two hundred years. In truth, she hasn't even served half the term Lord Progenitor set for her.
在黑金商会诺珐斯分部的员工眼里，苔佩希是远比会长“傲慢”更可怕的人。身为吸血鬼的她，比任何人都更了解该如何奴役亡灵。
The staff at the Novaris branch of the Adamant Syndicate fear Tephesia far more than they fear their leader, Pride. As a vampire, she knows better than anyone how to bend the Graveborn to her will.
苔佩希常常辩解她并非真的懒惰，只是拖延症严重，又碰不到有挑战性的工作。莫蒂默始祖对此嗤之以鼻，现任梅林却深以为然——至少在潜伏班题斯和黑金商会的任务上，她完成得不错。

Tephesia claims she isn't lazy, just prone to procrastination and starved of a challenge. Lord Progenitor scoffs, but the current Merlin agrees. At least she did well enough undercover in Bantus and the Adamant Syndicate.
别用那种奇怪的眼神盯着余。赤烛蕊的出现，可不是余的手笔。
Don't look at me like that. I had nothing to do with the candle blossom.
